# tapectl completions

[All commands](README.md)

Generate shell completions

```text
tapectl completions [OPTIONS] <SHELL>
```

**Arguments**

- `<SHELL>` *(one of `bash`, `elvish`, `fish`, `powershell`, `zsh`)* — Shell to generate completions for
